about:
Speed & Engine Warehouse traces its roots to 1920 when Car Parts Machine opened in downtown El Paso, Texas, offering precision engine machine work and engine parts. The business later adopted the Speed & Engine Warehouse name and expanded to a second location in Tucson, Arizona, where its headquarters are now based. The company remains privately held, though ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The company operates two facilities that combine a machine shop with a parts warehouse. Its core service is precision engine machining — including rebuilding and custom machine work — supplemented by a large inventory of engine kits and components covering passenger-car and industrial applications from Detroit Diesel to Honda. The Tucson and El Paso stores stock thousands of part numbers across categories such as rotating assemblies, gaskets, bearings, and performance components from hundreds of aftermarket brands.

Customers range from independent repair shops and engine builders to industrial maintenance teams and performance enthusiasts. The product lineup serves the automotive aftermarket, heavy-duty diesel, and industrial engine sectors, with specific coverage for brands like Detroit Diesel, Honda, and a wide array of racing and performance manufacturers.

The firm emphasizes its century-long continuity in engine machining and its broad stock availability as key differentiators, positioning itself as a single source for both machine work and the parts needed to complete a build.
